stem: What is the main difference between qc.measure_all() and manually calling qc.measure(q, c)?

options.A: measure_all() adds measurements but never adds classical bits
options.B: measure_all() measures all qubits into classical bits (creating them if needed), while manual measurement lets you choose mapping
options.C: Manual measurement always measures in the X basis
options.D: They are identical in every case

stem: You build a parameterized circuit with a Parameter("θ"). What is a correct way to evaluate it at θ = 0.3?

options.B: qc.bind_parameters({"θ": 0.3}) only (no other option exists)
options.C: Use parameter binding (e.g., assign/bind) to produce a bound circuit before execution/sampling
options.D: Parameters cannot be bound in Qiskit v2.x

stem: What does qc.cx(0,1) do?

options.A: Applies X on qubit 1 unconditionally
options.B: Applies X on qubit 0 controlled by qubit 1
options.C: Applies X on qubit 1 controlled by qubit 0

stem: In Qiskit, which statement is generally true about measured bitstrings?

options.A: The leftmost bit is always qubit 0
options.B: Bitstring order depends on classical bit/register ordering; always verify mapping used for measurement
options.C: Bitstrings are always returned in little-endian order, regardless of measurement mapping
options.D: Qiskit returns integers only, never bitstrings

stem: Which tool is most appropriate for quickly prototyping an algorithm with exact (noise-free) statevector simulation using SDK primitives?

options.A: StatevectorSampler / StatevectorEstimator
options.B: BackendSamplerV2 with a noisy device backend only
options.C: Only IBM Runtime can do statevector simulation

stem: Which function is commonly used to visualize shot-count outcomes as a histogram?

options.A: plot_histogram
options.B: plot_bloch_multivector

stem: plot_bloch_multivector(state) expects state to be:

options.A: A QuantumCircuit only
options.B: A quantum state object (e.g., Statevector/DensityMatrix) or equivalent array representation

stem: What is the primary goal of transpilation?

options.A: Convert quantum circuits into Python bytecode
options.B: Rewrite/optimize a circuit to satisfy a backend’s constraints (basis gates, connectivity, timing)
options.C: Encrypt a circuit so it can run securely
options.D: Replace quantum gates with classical logic gates

stem: In transpile(circuit, optimization_level=n), higher n generally means:

options.A: Fewer transformations and faster compilation always
options.B: More aggressive optimization passes (often slower compile time, potentially better circuits)

stem: What is the role of a Target in the Qiskit transpiler?

options.A: It stores measurement results
options.B: It describes backend constraints/instructions to guide compilation
options.C: It is only used for visualization
options.D: It is a synonym for QuantumCircuit

stem: If you pass backend=... to transpile() and also pass an explicit coupling_map=..., which is true?

options.A: The explicit coupling_map can override backend-derived constraints
options.B: The backend is ignored if any option is set

stem: Which statement is true?

options.A: A PassManager is a sequence of transpiler passes you can run on a circuit
options.B: Pass managers are only for classical compilation
options.D: Optimization levels do not use pass managers internally

stem: Preset pass managers are best described as:

options.A: Random pass sequences that change each run
options.B: Prebuilt staged pass managers corresponding to standard optimization levels and configurations

stem: Which pairing is correct?

options.A: Sampler → expectation values; Estimator → bitstring samples
options.B: Sampler → bitstring samples (from classical outputs); Estimator → expectation values of observables
options.D: Both do exactly the same thing

stem: In Qiskit v2.x, which statement is most accurate?

options.A: Only V1 primitives exist
options.B: V2 primitives (BaseSamplerV2, BaseEstimatorV2) are the current interfaces; older V1 interfaces are deprecated
options.D: Primitives only work on hardware, not simulators

stem: What is BackendSamplerV2 mainly used for?

options.A: Wrapping a BackendV2 so it can be used through the SamplerV2 interface
options.B: Drawing circuits

stem: Calling StatevectorEstimator.run(...) returns:

options.A: A matplotlib figure
options.B: A primitive job object; you retrieve the result via .result()

stem: A Sampler is designed to return:

options.A: Samples from classical output registers (bitstrings), possibly as quasi-probabilities depending on implementation
options.B: Only a unitary matrix

stem: To estimate ⟨Z⊗Z⟩ for a circuit with two qubits, Estimator conceptually needs:

options.A: Only the circuit, no observable
options.B: Only the observable, no circuit
options.C: A circuit and an observable (or list of observables)

stem: Which function exports a QuantumCircuit to an OpenQASM 3 string?

options.A: qiskit.qasm3.dump()
options.B: qiskit.qasm3.dumps()

stem: Which statement is most accurate about parsing OpenQASM 3 into a QuantumCircuit?

options.A: qiskit.qasm3.loads() works out-of-the-box for all OpenQASM 3 programs with no extra components
options.B: Import support can require the qiskit-qasm3-import extension, and feature support is evolving
options.C: Qiskit cannot export OpenQASM 3 at all

stem: When is transpilation typically necessary?

options.A: Always, even for pure statevector reference primitives
options.B: Typically when targeting a specific backend (hardware or backend-based execution) with constraints
options.D: Never; Qiskit runs any circuit on any backend

stem: Which is a common way to render a circuit diagram inside notebooks?

options.A: qc.draw() (and optionally qc.draw("mpl") when matplotlib is available)
options.B: plot_bloch_vector(qc)

stem: You measure qubit 1 into classical bit 0 and qubit 0 into classical bit 1. Which is true?

options.A: The resulting bitstrings will reflect that mapping; you must interpret bit positions via classical bits, not qubit indices
options.B: Qiskit automatically reorders results to qubit index order
options.C: This mapping is invalid and raises an error
options.D: The circuit becomes non-unitary and cannot run
